title: Green synthesis of iron oxide nanoparticles using Bacillus subtilis to mitigate salinity stress in rice (Oryza sativa L.) plants and enhance physiological activities
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,2421-2435
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN01184H, Paper
Hetvi Naik, Salim Manoharadas, Narayanasamy Bommayasamy, John Thomas, Muthukaruppan Gobi, Sahab Ram Dewala, Natarajan Amaresan
Bacillus subtilis was utilized for the synthesis of iron oxide nanoparticles (IONPs). This IONPs were used for the salinity stress management in rice plants.
